en: A color postcard showing a large round medieval stone bastion in the foreground, part of the city walls, with crenellations and small openings in the masonry. Behind it stands a yellow historic building complex with a tower and steep roof, surrounded by trees and garden walls. The reverse side has multilingual printed text identifying the site, address lines, stamp boxes and price information in Hungarian forints.
